# Public interface assets

- `roboto-latin.woff2`: Roboto Latin variable weight font from `@fontsource-variable/roboto` 5.3.0, weights 100–900. License retained in `ROBOTO-LICENSE.txt`. Served locally; no font-service requests.
- `noto-sans-latin.woff2`: Noto Sans Latin variable weight font from `@fontsource-variable/noto-sans` 5.3.0, weights 100–900. The active mobile typeface uses its wider humanist letterforms with compact heading sizes; this is not Samsung’s proprietary SamsungOne font. SIL Open Font License retained in `NOTO-SANS-LICENSE.txt`. Served locally and included in the digest-verified public PWA shell.
- `health-tiles.png`: Original generated transparent artwork for Food, Training, Sleep and Water. CSS displays the four equal sprite quadrants without changing the image. Decorative only; health values and chart shapes come from saved records.

These are public shell assets. Never add progress photos, mailbox attachments or private data here.
